script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: identity

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - DAY

A modern workspace buzzes with the hum of computers and the murmur of innovation. JESSICA (early 30s, intelligent, but weary) sits at her desk, staring at her computer screen. The fluorescent lights flicker, casting long, eerie shadows on her face.

Suddenly, JESSICA's COMPUTER screens a notification.

JESSICA
(reading aloud)
"You have been selected for a new project. Your team will be notified shortly."

Jessica's coworkers, JASON (late 20s, tech-savvy, smarmy), SAM (early 30s, introverted, kind), and OLIVIA (mid 30s, ambitious, confident), all gathered around the watercooler.

JASON
(laughing)
Well, well, well, look who finally got picked for something.

SAM
(smiling)
Congratulations, Jessica.

OLIVIA
(sarcastically)
Yes, because everyone knows your work ethic is unparalleled.

Jessica rolls her eyes and pours herself a cup of coffee.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

Jessica, Jason, Sam, and Olivia sit around a table, flanked by their manager, MARK (40s, serious, fair).

MARK
Welcome, team. You've all been chosen to work on our latest project: a revolutionary new app that focuses on personal identity. You have six weeks to complete it.

The team exchanges glances, their eyes wide with anticipation.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - JESSICA'S DESK - NIGHT

Jessica hunches over her computer, her fingers flying across the keyboard. As the days pass, she becomes more and more consumed by the project, neglecting her personal life.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - CAFETERIA - DAY

Sam approaches Jessica, concern etched on his face.

SAM
(gently)
Hey, Jessica. You've been working non-stop for days now. You need to take a break.

Jessica looks up, her eyes red from lack of sleep.

JESSICA
(defensively)
I can't. We're behind schedule.

Sam places a hand on her shoulder.

SAM
(kindly)
Then let me help. We can work together.

Jessica hesitates for a moment before nodding.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - JASON'S DESK - DAY

Jason smirks as he watches Jessica and Sam work together, their heads bent over their computers. He pulls out his phone and begins to type.

JASON
(typing)
"Jessica's softening. Sam's getting in her head. Project's in the bag."

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - CONFERENCE ROOM - WEEK 6

The team gathers around the table once more, their faces reflecting both relief and anxiety.

MARK
Well done, team. You've all done an excellent job on this project.

As the team celebrates, Jessica looks on, a sense of emptiness settling in her chest. She realizes that in her quest to prove herself, she had lost sight of who she was.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - JESSICA'S DESK - NIGHT

Jessica packs up her things, her computer screen displaying the finished app. She takes a deep breath and logs off.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
